## About this catalogue

Entries appear after publication and fresh-retrieval verification. Data remain in Goldmine; this site presents metadata and retrieval instructions.

Prospects can change between versions. Refined releases follow a stricter schedule.

See the [Operator Manual](overview.qmd) to register and publish a dataset.
